source.title: Newly inspected original Enchantrix account exports, empty local processing counters

notes: Four previously uninspected GitHub-hosted SavedVariables accounts from four separate repositories were read, not inferred from snippets. All have empty EnchantedLocal, ProspectedLocal and MillingLocal. These are exhausted negative leads, not experimental zero yields. Name-based searches covered at least three sites and six separate queries. Original Warmaul Looter, Cobalt and Fel Iron sample aggregates already archived and not repeated. AH catalog ilvl evidence is not a Retail player DE eligibility test.
lookingFor: Independent original completed per-item Warmaul Legplates disenchant or Cobalt/Fel Iron five-ore prospect events, plus uncopied Enchantrix account output-hit/zero histograms
whereLooked: Warmaul Legplates name search, WoWDB current scaled item 24995 (no-DE catalog flag), Wowhead TBC item 24995 (old ilvl108), and current Wowhead retail variants (ilvl14/74): no new dated player item-instance completed DE log.

Warmaul Legplates name search on BootyBayBroker item 24995 (https://bootybaybroker.com/item/24995/warmaul-legplates/us/alleria) independently corroborates ilvl31 contemporary catalog/AH item; not an actual enchant eligibility trial nor output statistics.
Cobalt Ore name search, Wowhead MoP Classic Cobalt Ore and r/woweconomy: only prior 180-ore/24-stack groups and no newly attributable 0-N per-material event ledger.
Fel Iron Ore name search, Wowhead WotLK/TBC and Wow-Professions TBC prospecting: historical aggregate studies/reference tables, no new exact completed-cast+hit-count matched source.
Warmaul Legplates name search Warcraft Wiki, historical expansion-variant item levels and disenchanting groups: no first-person cast log.
